name: Stores Repositories On Volume
description: A Gitaly node keeps its repositories on this volume. The target is open: an attached EBS volume (aws_core__aws_ebs_volume) here. GitLab supports only local block storage for Gitaly; the filesystem property makes an unsupported NFS or EFS mount visible.

storage_name.description: The repository storage served from this volume.

mount_path.description: Where the volume is mounted in the Gitaly container.

filesystem.description: The filesystem the repositories sit on. nfs and efs are unsupported by GitLab.
